federal.title: Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 (post-Bostock)
federal.citation: 42 U.S.C. § 2000e et seq.; Bostock v. Clayton County, 590 U.S. ___ (2020)
federal.summary: Federal employment discrimination law prohibits discrimination on the basis of sex, which the Supreme Court has held includes discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation and gender identity.

federal.title: Fair Housing Act
federal.summary: Federal fair housing law prohibits discrimination on the basis of sex; HUD interprets this to include gender identity.

federal.title: Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act
federal.summary: Federal civil rights law prohibiting discrimination in covered health programs and activities on the basis of sex, including gender identity.
